## LOAD DATA

```{r load, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Load corrected microbiome ∩ diet ∩ WGS object (103 birds)
microb_overlap_otu <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/wgs_microb_corrected.rds")) %>%
  biomeUtils::removeZeros()

# Add TipID column for tree-matching
sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$TipID_microbiome <- paste(
  sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Lab_Code,
  sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Species_Label, sep = "_")

# Diet object (already overlap-filtered)
diet_fr <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/diet_overlap_microb_corrected.rds"))

# Generate per-taxonomic-level glommed objects
tax_levels <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species", "OTU99")

ps_by_level <- lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  if (lvl == "OTU99") microb_overlap_otu
  else speedyseq::tax_glom(microb_overlap_otu, lvl)
})
names(ps_by_level) <- tax_levels

# Sanity check
sapply(ps_by_level, function(x) nrow(sample_data(x)))

```

## GEOGRAPHIC DISTANCE

```{r geo, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

my_points <- data.frame(
  longitude = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Xdec,
  latitude = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Ydec,
  Island_Mainland = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Island_Mainland,
  row.names = sample_names(microb_overlap_otu))

dist_mat <- distm(cbind(my_points$longitude, my_points$latitude), fun = distGeo) / 1000
rownames(dist_mat) <- rownames(my_points)
colnames(dist_mat) <- rownames(my_points)
geo_dist <- as.dist(dist_mat)
lgeo_dist <- as.dist(log10(geo_dist + 1))

```

## MICROBIOME DISTANCES

```{r microb-dist, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Helper that returns Bray, Jaccard, and UniFrac distances for one phyloseq object,
# with rows in the same order as dist_mat
compute_dists <- function(ps, sample_order) {
  # Reorder samples to match dist_mat
  ps_ordered <- prune_samples(sample_order, ps)
  tab <- otu_table(ps_ordered)
  
  # Ensure OTU table has samples as rows for vegdist
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_ordered)) {
    tab_matrix <- as.matrix(tab)
  } else {
    tab_matrix <- t(as.matrix(tab))
  }
  
  list(
    bray        = vegdist(tab_matrix, method = "bray"),
    jaccard     = vegdist(tab_matrix, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE),
    unifrac_uw  = UniFrac(ps_ordered, weighted = FALSE),
    unifrac_w   = UniFrac(ps_ordered, weighted = TRUE)
  )
}

# Compute distances for all taxonomic levels
microb_dists <- lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  message("Computing distances for: ", lvl)
  compute_dists(ps_by_level[[lvl]], sample_order = rownames(dist_mat))
})
names(microb_dists) <- tax_levels

```

## DIET DISTANCES

```{r diet-dist, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

diet_overlap <- prune_samples(sample_names(diet_fr) %in% sample_names(microb_overlap_otu), diet_fr)
diet_overlap <- prune_samples(rownames(dist_mat), diet_overlap)

diet_tab <- otu_table(diet_overlap)
if (taxa_are_rows(diet_overlap)) {
  diet_tab <- t(diet_tab)
}

diet_bray_dist    <- vegdist(diet_tab, method = "bray")
diet_jaccard_dist <- vegdist(diet_tab, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
diet_rc_dist      <- raupcrick(diet_tab)

```

## HOST PHYLOGENETIC DISTANCE

```{r host, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

fringilla_tree <- read.tree(file = paste0(dataDir, "/mt_Fringilla_aln.fasta.contree"))
fringilla_tree$tip.label <- gsub("_mtDNA", "", fringilla_tree$tip.label)

annot <- read_delim(paste0(dataDir, "/WGS_Fringilla_samples.tsv"))

# Rename tree tips to match microbiome IDs
fringilla_tree$tip.label <- annot[match(fringilla_tree$tip.label, annot$WGS_ID), ]$TipID_microbiome

microb_overlap_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(microb_overlap_otu))

# Subset tree to matching IDs
fringilla_tree_subset <- as.treedata.table(
  tree = fringilla_tree, data = microb_overlap_meta,
  name_column = "TipID_microbiome")$phy

fringilla_rootedtree <- root(fringilla_tree_subset, outgroup = "149_Tenerife_F_teydea",
                             resolve.root = TRUE)

# Host distance matrix in same row order as dist_mat
host_dist_full <- cophenetic.phylo(fringilla_tree_subset)
host_dist <- as.dist(host_dist_full[rownames(dist_mat), colnames(dist_mat)])

```

## MANTEL TEST HELPER

```{r mantel-helper, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Distance metric names for iteration
dist_metrics <- c("bray", "jaccard", "unifrac_uw", "unifrac_w")
dist_labels <- c("Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard", "Unweighted UniFrac", "Weighted UniFrac")
names(dist_labels) <- dist_metrics

# Runs simple Mantel test for one microbiome distance and one predictor distance
mantel_pair <- function(microb_dist, predictor_dist, taxon, dist_name) {
  m_simple <- vegan::mantel(microb_dist, predictor_dist,
                            method = "pearson", permutations = 9999)
  
  data.frame(taxonomy = taxon, dist = dist_name,
             r = round(m_simple$statistic, 4), 
             p = m_simple$signif)
}

# Run mantel_pair across all 7 taxonomic levels for all 4 distance metrics
mantel_across_levels <- function(predictor_dist) {
  bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
    bind_rows(lapply(dist_metrics, function(metric) {
      mantel_pair(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]], predictor_dist, 
                  lvl, dist_labels[metric])
    }))
  }))
}

```


## MANTEL: GEOGRAPHIC DISTANCE

```{r mantel-geo, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}
# Simple Mantel test: microbiome ~ geographic distance
mantel_geo_simple <- function(microb_dist, taxon, dist_name) {
  m <- vegan::mantel(microb_dist, lgeo_dist, method = "pearson", permutations = 9999)
  data.frame(taxonomy = taxon, dist = dist_name,
             r = round(m$statistic, 4), p = m$signif)
}

# Partial Mantel test: microbiome ~ geographic distance | host phylogenetic distance
mantel_geo_partial <- function(microb_dist, taxon, dist_name) {
  m <- vegan::mantel.partial(microb_dist, lgeo_dist, host_dist,
                             method = "pearson", permutations = 9999)
  data.frame(taxonomy = taxon, dist = dist_name,
             r = round(m$statistic, 4), p = m$signif)
}

# Run simple Mantel across all levels and distance metrics
mantel_out_geo <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  bind_rows(lapply(dist_metrics, function(metric) {
    mantel_geo_simple(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]], lvl, dist_labels[metric])
  }))
}))

# Run partial Mantel across all levels and distance metrics
mantel_out_geo_partial <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  bind_rows(lapply(dist_metrics, function(metric) {
    mantel_geo_partial(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]], lvl, dist_labels[metric])
  }))
}))

mantel_out_geo <- mantel_out_geo %>%
  mutate(p = round(p, 4))

mantel_out_geo_partial <- mantel_out_geo_partial %>%
  mutate(p = round(p, 4))

write.csv(mantel_out_geo, paste0(dataDir, "/output_mantel_geo.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(mantel_out_geo_partial, paste0(dataDir, "/output_mantel_geo_partial.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kable(mantel_out_geo %>% filter(taxonomy == "Species"),
      caption = "Simple Mantel: Geographic distance (Species level)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

kable(mantel_out_geo_partial %>% filter(taxonomy == "Species"),
      caption = "Partial Mantel: Geographic distance, controlling for host phylogenetic distance (Species level)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

```

## MRM AND VARIANCE PARTITIONING

```{r varpart-helper, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Distance metrics for MRM (UniFrac excluded — results consistent, reduces complexity)
mrm_metrics <- c("bray", "jaccard")
mrm_labels <- c("Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard")
names(mrm_labels) <- mrm_metrics

# Variance partitioning for one microbiome distance, with host/diet/geo predictors
varpart_one <- function(microb_dist, taxon, dist_name, diet_dist = diet_rc_dist) {
  full   <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + diet_dist + lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_host <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_geo  <- MRM(microb_dist ~ lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_diet <- MRM(microb_dist ~ diet_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_hd   <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + diet_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_hg   <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_dg   <- MRM(microb_dist ~ diet_dist + lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
  
  H  <- m_host$r.squared[1]
  G  <- m_geo$r.squared[1]
  D  <- m_diet$r.squared[1]
  HD <- m_hd$r.squared[1]
  HG <- m_hg$r.squared[1]
  DG <- m_dg$r.squared[1]
  total <- full$r.squared[1]
  
  vp <- varPart(A = H, B = D, C = G,
                AB = HD, AC = HG, BC = DG, ABC = total,
                A.name = "host", B.name = "diet", C.name = "geo")
  vp$pop_ind <- "Individual"
  vp$distance <- dist_name
  vp$tax <- taxon
  vp$variable <- rownames(vp)
  vp
}

```

```{r varpart-run, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Run varpart across all 7 taxonomic levels × 2 distance metrics (Bray & Jaccard)
varpart_results <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  message("Running varpart at level: ", lvl)
  bind_rows(lapply(mrm_metrics, function(metric) {
    varpart_one(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]], lvl, mrm_labels[metric])
  }))
}))

# Set negative proportions to 0 and convert to percent
varpart_results$Proportion <- pmax(varpart_results$Proportion, 0)
varpart_results$percent <- round(varpart_results$Proportion * 100, 2)
varpart_results$tax <- factor(varpart_results$tax,
                              levels = c("OTU99", "Species", "Genus", "Family",
                                         "Order", "Class", "Phylum"))

write.csv(varpart_results, paste0(dataDir, "/output_varpart.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kable(varpart_results %>% filter(tax == "Species") %>% 
        select(distance, variable, percent),
      caption = "Variance partitioning (Species level)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

```

## MRM FULL MODEL RESULTS

```{r mrm-full, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Extract full MRM model coefficients for all taxonomic levels and distance metrics
# Includes individual R² for each predictor from single-predictor models
mrm_full_one <- function(microb_dist, taxon, dist_name, diet_dist = diet_rc_dist) {
  full   <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + diet_dist + lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_host <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_diet <- MRM(microb_dist ~ diet_dist, nperm = 9999)
  m_geo  <- MRM(microb_dist ~ lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
  
  coefs <- data.frame(full$coef)
  coefs$predictor <- rownames(coefs)
  coefs$taxonomy <- taxon
  coefs$distance <- dist_name
  coefs$R2_full <- full$r.squared[1]
  coefs$F_stat <- full$F.test[1]
  coefs$F_p <- full$F.test[2]
  
  # Add individual R² for each predictor
  coefs$R2_individual <- NA
  coefs$R2_individual[coefs$predictor == "host_dist"] <- m_host$r.squared[1]
  coefs$R2_individual[coefs$predictor == "diet_dist"] <- m_diet$r.squared[1]
  coefs$R2_individual[coefs$predictor == "lgeo_dist"] <- m_geo$r.squared[1]
  
  coefs %>%
    rename(estimate = microb_dist, p_value = pval) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxonomy, distance, predictor, estimate, p_value, R2_individual, R2_full, F_stat, F_p)
}

mrm_results <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  message("Running MRM at level: ", lvl)
  bind_rows(lapply(mrm_metrics, function(metric) {
    mrm_full_one(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]], lvl, mrm_labels[metric])
  }))
}))

mrm_results <- mrm_results %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 5),
    R2_individual = round(R2_individual, 4),
    R2_full = round(R2_full, 4),
    F_stat = round(F_stat, 2),
    p_value = round(p_value, 4),
    F_p = round(F_p, 4)
  )

write.csv(mrm_results, paste0(dataDir, "/output_mrm_full.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kable(mrm_results %>% filter(taxonomy == "Species"),
      caption = "MRM full model results (Species level)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

```
